Day spa in the 1912 bathhouse · Freiburg

Heat, water and an hour where nobody needs you.

A cedar sauna at 90 °C, a steam bath, a pool under the old glass roof - and treatments that start on the minute and never run over. Every treatment of 45 minutes or more includes the bathhouse for the day.

How it arrives
The bathhouse

Six rooms, from 12 to 90 degrees

The city built the bathhouse in 1912 for people without a bathroom. We kept the tiles, the glass roof and the order: hot, then cold, then rest.

Pool 31 °C

Sixteen metres under the 1912 glass roof, for floating rather than lengths.

Depth
1.35 m
Open
all day

Tiled benches, eucalyptus in the steam and a cold shower by the door.

Quiet hours

Every day from 13:00 to 15:00, and from 20:00 until we close. No talking in the sauna area and the quiet room, and phones stay in the locker.

What to bring, and how it works

Bring

  • SwimwearFor the pool and the steam bath.
  • Flip-flopsOr buy a pair at the desk for €6.
  • Something to readThe quiet room has lamps, and no signal.

We have

  • Robe and towelsTwo towels and a sauna sheet, changed as often as you like.
  • Showers and hair dryersShampoo and body wash in every shower.
  • Tea and waterAll day, and fruit in the tea room.

In the sauna

  • Without swimwearThe sauna area is textile-free - sit on your sheet, all of you.
  • Shower firstBefore every round, and after the cold plunge.
  • From 14 yearsChildren aged 14 to 17 come with an adult.

Privacy

What we keep, and for how long.

Bookings

Your name, email and the notes you give us, to hold the time and to tell your therapist what matters. We delete them twelve months after your last visit.

Vouchers

The names and the message on the voucher, kept until it is used or three years have passed.

This website

No tracking and no cookies. The fonts come from Google Fonts, the photos from a picture service.
